query: What entity is responsible for administering the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015?
reference_answer: The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.
answer: The MediShield Life Scheme is administered by the Health Fund under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015. [Document 1]
